$comment: Source of truth: Holochain DHT (sub-shape of attestation:identity-freeze's evidence_json.summary_metric). Category A. This is a derived attestation — synthesized when a governance-action:identity-challenge reaches challenge-support quorum.
title: IdentityFreezeAttestationMetadata
description: Per-subtype metadata for attestation:identity-freeze. Asserts that an identity has been frozen following a governance-action:identity-challenge that reached quorum. Replaces imagodei's IdentityFreeze entry type.

freeze_duration_hours.description: Optional duration of the freeze; null means indefinite

derived_from_challenge_cid.description: CID of the originating governance-action:identity-challenge if this freeze was derived from a challenge tally
